interpretation: Asymmetric result: within male/lab speakers accuracy is STRONG (0.311 vs chance 0.142) -- region is genuinely predictable on unseen lab-recorded speakers, so the accent signal in that half of the corpus is real, not channel. Within female/app speakers accuracy is AT OR BELOW chance (0.115 vs 0.126) -- either the app-recording channel carries less separable accent signal (compression, mic variability), or region is simply harder to detect from these speakers/regions with current methods. Do not report the pooled number as if it applies uniformly to the whole corpus -- report both halves and flag the female/app gap as an open question, not a null result to hide.
